title: Notice
description: A link somebody put out — a video, a magazine, a product — and one line about it. A pointer, never content: the system that holds the link holds what it says, and whoever carries the notice only says that the link exists and when.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

by.description: The wallet, handle, or id under localIds of whoever put the link out.

url.description: Where the link goes. https, so a page vouching for it can hand it to a machine.

line.description: One line about it, in the words of whoever put it out. Read by a person; never fetched from the link.

createdAt.description: When the notice was recorded, which is not when the link was published.
